personas.name: Developer with a coding agent
personas.wants: Stop re-explaining the project to the agent and get the same result on the tenth task as on the first

personas.name: Tech lead of a team using agents
personas.wants: Make every teammate's agent follow the same rules, reviewed like code

personas.name: Platform and security engineer
personas.wants: Run infra and security changes through the same checked steps every time, with rollback and evidence

token savings or speed-ups as numbers (the site's run 1 to run 10 numbers are illustrative, not a benchmark)
that the agent or model is trained or fine-tuned (it changes markdown, not weights)
customer or company names, and contributors' names
"works with any agent" as a tested fact
